metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the shunt gateway: subagents for the models it diverts to other providers, and a mod for the gateway's own pool usage.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: A Claude Mod for the gateway itself: /shunt:usage shows the shared account pool's remaining headroom and reset times, read from GET /usage. Requires function hooks (early access).

plugins.name: shunt-codex
plugins.description: Subagents on ChatGPT/Codex GPT-6 models (Sol, Luna) and GPT-5.6 models (Luna, Sol, Terra), routed through shunt at the inference layer.

plugins.name: shunt-xai
plugins.description: Subagents on xAI Grok models (grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-build-0.1), routed through shunt at the inference layer. EXPERIMENTAL — the xAI provider is not yet verified against the live API.

plugins.name: shunt-kimi
plugins.description: Subagent on Moonshot AI's kimi-k2.7-code, routed through shunt at the inference layer via Moonshot's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

plugins.name: shunt-deepseek
plugins.description: Subagents on DeepSeek models (deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash), routed through shunt at the inference layer via DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

plugins.name: shunt-zai
plugins.description: Subagents on Z.ai GLM models (glm-5.2, glm-4.7), routed through shunt at the inference layer via Z.ai's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

plugins.name: shunt-minimax
plugins.description: Subagent on MiniMax-M3 (1M context), routed through shunt at the inference layer via MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

plugins.name: shunt-mimo
plugins.description: Subagent on Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5-pro, routed through shunt at the inference layer via Mimo's Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
